items.t: Paved and roofed area went from 1.8% in 1985 to 3.0% in 2025 across 125 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).
0 of 125 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life; 22 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
0 of 125 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 1 of 1 high-need ones have none.
